card.fact_statement: The 2025 Chile blackout was triggered by the disconnection of a critical 500 kV high-voltage transmission line.
card.source_span: led to the disconnection of a critical 500 kV high-voltage transmission line
aliases: disconnection of a 500 kV transmission line

target_qa_variants.question: Ni tukio gani linalohusisha njia muhimu ya usambazaji umeme wa msongo mkubwa wa kV 500 lililosababisha kukatika kwa umeme nchini Chile mwaka 2025?
answer_aliases: kukatwa kwa njia ya usambazaji umeme ya kV 500
target_qa_variants.source_span: led to the disconnection of a critical 500 kV high-voltage transmission line
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'disconnection' as 'kukatwa' (cutting/disconnection) which is standard for power lines in Swahili.

backtranslation_en.question: What event involving a critical 500 kV high-voltage power transmission line caused a power outage in Chile in 2025?
answer_aliases: cutting of the 500 kV power transmission line

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The target language QA accurately translates the source QA and preserves the same fact and expected answer.
